GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 400.12 (8 Nov 48) CTS/L
(SCAPIN - 1953/2)
APO 500
24 May 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Establishment of an Adequate Procurement Policy for the Japanese Government Railways.
1. References:
a. SCAPIN 1953, AG 400.12 (8 Nov 48) CTS-R, subject as above, dated 30 December 1948.
b. SCAPIN 1953/1, AG 400.12 (8 Nov 48) CTS, subject as above, dated 7 October 1949.
2. This directive authorizes a special exception to the referenced directives.
3. The exception covers the sale of approximately 15,000 tons of various and sundry alloy steels which are surplus to the needs of the Japanese National Railways.
4. The Japanese Government is authorized in this case to permit the Japanese National Railways to advertise for bids limiting the bidders and awards of sale to manufacturers of record with the Economic Stabilization Board who certify that the materials are required for their own use and will not be resold: provided further that all such advertisements and awards shall be on small lots of a size acceptable to the average bidder.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K. W. BUSH
Brigadier General, USA
Adjutant General.
